sources.summary: Her catchy videos have racked up billions of views, but Rachel Accurso’s statements on everything from Gaza to LGBTQ rights have caused a stir. She talks about screen time, song fatigue and speculation she might enter politics The YouTube star Ms Rachel, toddler whisperer extraordinaire, spots me before I clock her, and even from a distance and without her trademark pink T-shirt and denim dungarees, she is instantly recognisable by her wave, which is accompanied by an enthusiastic bounce. I half expect her to say, “Hi, friends”, as she does at the start of many of her videos. Instead she bounds over, wearing a classic off-duty mum uniform – Sesame Street sweatshirt, grey leggings, baseball cap that reads “Mama” – and removes her oversized sunglasses. She’s very sorry, she says, rubbing her eyes, that she is so tired – but her manner remains unfailingly, characteristically peppy. It is only seven years since Rachel Accurso, who used to be a preschool music teacher, uploaded her first video to YouTube, a counting song for preschoolers called Bubble, Bubble Pop! . She and her husband, Aron Accurso, who worked as a music director on Broadway, made the video because their one-year-old son had a speech delay and there seemed to be a dearth of quality videos online that could help toddlers learn to speak. items.context: 文件顯示，美國環保署（EPA）允許農化巨頭拜耳（Bayer），從一份選項清單中自行挑選除草劑「麥草畏」（dicamba）的管制規則，再把拜耳的選擇直接寫進聯邦法規草案。麥草畏因容易飄散、破壞鄰近作物而備受爭議，這批內部文件也罕見揭露了農藥法規制定過程通常不為外界所見的一面。

items.context: 美國參議員伯尼・桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）提案修改聯邦加班規則：只要每週工時超過32小時，雇主就得支付至少1.5倍加班費（現行門檻是40小時），且會分階段實施。這是一篇評論文章的觀點——作者認同桑德斯想推動四天工作制的方向，但認為用加班費強制規定的做法，不如用誘因引導雇主轉型來得有效。
